name: Kanchipuram Silk Sarees
popularFabric: Pure Mulberry Silk & Pure Gold Zari
description: The queen of South Indian handlooms, woven with triple-twisted silk thread and pure gold-silver zari borders featuring temple motifs.

name: Banarasi Sarees
description: Opulent weaves from the holy city of Varanasi, boasting Mughal-inspired floral jaals, shikargah hunt scenes, and rich brocade work.

name: Mysore Silk Sarees
description: Famed royal drape of the Wadiyar dynasty crafted with 100% pure silk and 0.65% pure silver with 24-carat gold electroplating.

name: Gadwal Sarees
description: Unique heritage weave with a lightweight cotton or silk body interlaced seamlessly with rich kuttu-interlocked silk borders.

name: Pochampally Ikat Sarees
description: GI-tagged double ikat marvels where yarns are tie-dyed with mathematical precision to form hypnotic geometric diamond patterns.

name: Uppada Sarees
description: Featherlight Jamdani weaving technique from the Godavari coast, featuring gossamer textures and non-structural weft motifs.

name: Dharmavaram Sarees
description: Renowned for broad multi-colored borders and rich pallus with intricate peacocks and elephant motifs favored for bridal muhurthams.

name: Chanderi Sarees
description: Sheer, airy, gossamer drapes dating back to the Vedic era, embellished with delicate gold buttis and translucent shimmering textures.

name: Paithani Sarees
description: The Maharashtrian royal heirloom characterized by kaleidoscopic borders, oblique square designs, and radiant mor (peacock) pallus.

name: Patola Sarees
description: Patan's legendary double-ikat masterpiece taking months to weave; colors never fade and both front and back are identical.

name: Sambalpuri Sarees
description: Traditional Baandha tie-dye weave showcasing sacred symbols of Shankha (conch), Chakra (wheel), and phula (floral flora).

name: Tussar Silk Sarees
description: Natural gold sheen silk harvested from wild silkworms, celebrated for its rich porous texture and artisanal Madhubani tribal painting.

name: Kota Doria Sarees
description: Delicately woven square grid checks (khats) creating an ethereal, featherlight summer drape seasoned with onion juice and rice paste.

name: Chikankari Sarees
description: The refined Nawabi embroidery of Lucknow featuring tepchi, bakhiya, and phanda hand needlework on whisper-soft pastels.

name: Linen Sarees
description: Modern breathability infused with sustainable rustic elegance, featuring minimal zari selvedges and artisanal hand-block prints.

name: Cotton Sarees
description: Everyday comfort meets timeless heritage from Bengal Tant, Mangalagiri, to Chettinad breathable handspun cottons.

name: Organza Sarees
description: Airy, crisp, and glamorous with delicate hand-painted floral motifs, gota patti scalloped cutwork, and romantic silhouettes.

name: Georgette Sarees
description: Graceful drapes that flow effortlessly with every step, adorned with badla zari, delicate sequins, and festive bandhani motifs.

name: Chiffon Sarees
description: Royal Rajasthani signature drape beloved by Maharani Gayatri Devi, featuring leheriya dye effects and whisper-light flow.

name: Designer Sarees
description: Contemporary couture creations featuring pre-draped silhouettes, concept belts, sculpted ruffles, and glamorous crystal embellishments.

name: Bridal Sarees
description: Grand heirloom masterpieces for life's most sacred moments, richly adorned with vermilion reds, real gold zari, and bridal shringar.

name: Party Wear Sarees
description: Dazzling evening statements tailored for sangeets, cocktail receptions, and festive gala soirees.

name: Daily Wear Sarees
description: Effortless, all-day breathable sarees with soft skin feel, easy care, and timeless everyday elegance.
